description: Search OPEN public procurements of Belarus (submission deadline not passed) by words in the title or customer name, or by the customer UNP (9 digits); optional region. Each item: title, customer, deadline, price, procedure, source platform link and the AI-TENDER card. Ordered by deadline. Поиск открытых закупок Беларуси.

limit.description: Maximum number of open procurements to return, 1–25 (default 10)

query.description: Words from the title or customer, or customer UNP

region.description: Region name as returned by list_regions

name: search_tenders

outputSchema.description: Open procurements matching query and scope boundaries, or an error object.

count.description: Number of procurements returned in items

does_not_establish.description: Boundary statements clarifying what absence or presence does not prove

error.description: Error object returned when parameters are invalid (e.g. unknown_region)

items.description: Open public procurement records ordered by submission deadline

scope.description: Explicit coverage and open-deadline scope statement

title: Open public procurements of Belarus
